title: ClaimDesk rating export: JDK 8 to JDK 21 without changing a byte of the feed
scenario: Corvane Mutual's reinsurance rating export is a Java 8 module of the ClaimDesk monolith. The platform team is retiring the JDK 8 hosts; on JDK 21 the module does not compile, and once it does it fails at startup. The reinsurer's COBOL parser accepts only byte-identical envelopes, and golden masters captured from production are your contract.
task: Build for release 21; replace JAXB-from-the-JDK with Jakarta XML Binding 4 plus a runtime
Replace sun.misc.BASE64Encoder with java.util.Base64 without changing the envelope bytes
Remove the reflective default-charset hack instead of adding --add-opens
Write the change log in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Hidden characterization tests: envelopes and XML byte-identical to the production golden masters, including accented names
Class files are version 65; no sun.misc, setAccessible, javax.xml.bind or --add-opens left
The nightly batch runs end to end
ANSWER.md explains each breakage, which JDK release caused it, and the rollout
